findings.title: A4 and A3 contradict each other on whether collapse-all skips pinned tool windows
findings.detail: A4-R3 7.5 collapseAll sets every non-pinned window to hidden (pinned survive). A3-R3 D-A3-7 takes the opposite reading: collapse everything together with one-click restore. R3 global constraints list both 'collapse all' and 'pin/unpin' without resolving the interaction.
findings.impact: A persistence contract and a state machine would encode different restored layouts; W19 would ship whichever lane A0 integrates last.
findings.owner: A10 ruling, then A3 + A4 reconcile, A1 prototype shows the chosen behaviour

findings.title: A5 delivered nothing, so the database daily loop (J2) has no R3 acceptance evidence
findings.detail: codex/m5-w18-a5 is still at origin/master 200f0f1. No database-in-shell report, no revised DB prototype. A1's database mode is therefore unvalidated against A5's own design lane.
findings.impact: RESOLVED: A5 delivered codex/m5-w18-a5 6bc4942 (A5-R3-prototype.html covers connection / sql / result / cancel / bounded grid / null-truncation at the four sizes); J2 probe re-enabled below. Remaining: A5's DB mode must still be folded into A1's consolidated prototype.
findings.owner: A5; A11 re-probe PASS; A1 revision still needed to fold DB mode into the consolidated prototype

findings.title: The consolidated prototype demonstrates only part of the 14-unit Git workflow
findings.detail: A1-R3-prototype.html contains hunk/stash/cherry-pick/branch/log/graph but has no occurrence of worktree, blame, amend, reset, revert, conflict, patch, command-log or diff. Those units exist only in A1-R3-browser-workbench.md 7 table. A7 requires all 14 units to be demonstrable at the four sizes plus failure/empty/conflict states.
findings.impact: The user-review checklist cannot be completed for 9 of 14 Git units from the prototype alone.

findings.title: Collapsed-mode geometry is reported under three different measurement conventions
findings.detail: 1440x900 collapsed: A1 93.0% H / 96.0% W; A3 92.4% H / 100.0% W; A8 93.3% H / 100.0% W. All three pass the 85/92 gate, but width differs by 4.0pp because A1 reserves an edge strip and A3/A8 do not, and A8 subtracts a 32px OS titlebar first.
findings.impact: A future W19 assertion script would encode one convention and silently contradict the other two reports.
findings.owner: A0 to freeze one post-titlebar definition; A2 owns the measuring method

findings.title: Top-chrome height budget is quoted three ways (68 / 65 / 60 px)
findings.detail: A1 measures nav row + tab strip = 68px; A8 counts 32px activity bar and 65px with one expand row; A2 proposes a 60px budget that reserves 15px for a desktop scrollbar. All are <= 80px, so the gate passes, but the definitions are not interchangeable.
findings.impact: Same as F-A11-4 for an automated chrome-height assertion.

findings.title: The consolidated prototype carries no accessibility attributes
findings.detail: A1-R3-prototype.html has zero occurrences of 'aria-' or 'role='. A6-R3 11 requires role=menuitem / aria-disabled / focus moves into menu / Esc returns focus, A8-R3 3 requires a 2px focus ring, and A3's prototype does implement aria/role. The A1 draft therefore cannot demonstrate the accessibility acceptance items.
findings.impact: Accessibility rows of the user-review checklist are not executable against the current consolidated prototype.

findings.title: Command-entry shortcut is not frozen: A1 uses Ctrl+Shift+P, A2's budget frame uses Ctrl+K
findings.detail: A1-R3-browser-workbench.md 2.1/3.8 binds Ctrl+Shift+P; A2-R3-shell-density-audit.md 7.3 draws 'Ctrl+K'. One must be chosen before the palette is implemented.
findings.impact: Minor, but it would ship as an inconsistency in the first W19 shell slice.
findings.owner: A0 ruling; A6 registers the binding

findings.title: 800x600 is in the workbench blueprint but unreachable in the current product
findings.detail: A2 measured that main.rs min_inner_size(900,600) makes 800x600 impossible; the R3 card lists four sizes and does not include 800x600. A2 asks A0 to decide between changing the minimum window size (product code) or dropping the size.
findings.impact: Acceptance scope ambiguity; A11 keeps 800x600 as a deferred decision item rather than a checklist row.

findings.title: Rebased pinned revision disagrees between A7 (cee14e9) and A10 (2896562e)
findings.detail: A7-R3-git-workflow-reference-map.md pinned DetachHead/rebased at cee14e9 and mapped all COPY/ADAPT units against it. A10's reference/license review fixes the canonical pin at 2896562e69ff2cac3c90eb3aae4bcce0d4aa9a99 (2026-09-06). The two SHAs are not the same commit, so every unit's COPY/ADAPT provenance reference in A7 may point at the wrong revision.
findings.impact: W19 cannot adopt any COPY/ADAPT unit until the canonical SHA is reconciled; adopting A7's pin would cite un-reviewed code, adopting A10's would invalidate A7's per-unit evidence without re-verification.
findings.owner: A0 / A10 (final reconciliation); A11 manifest now adopts A10's authoritative pin
